title: Tabcorp Holdings and Tatts Group - proposed merger

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
Former provisional date for announcement of ACCC's findings (23rd February 2017) delayed to allow the merger parties to provide additional information.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns.

Tabcorp announced that it has withdrawn its request for ACCC informal merger review and has lodged an application for merger authorisation with the Australian Competition Tribunal. Consequently, the ACCC has discontinued its review without making a final decision. The former proposed decision date of the review was 4 May 2017.
